target.statement: Test accuracy of Detach-ROCKET (c=0.1) on FordB: 81.05 ± 0.64% (mean over 25 repetitions), compared to full ROCKET 80.37 ± 0.61%.

compute.basis: Estimate based on 25 repetitions of ROCKET (10,000 kernels) + SFD pruning (150 steps) on FordB (3,636 train, 810 test), each involving ridge regression on up to 20,000 features; CPU-only, but 25 runs make it a few hours.

blockers: Code repository may not include exact scripts/configs for Table 1 (partial release).

title: Detach-ROCKET: Sequential feature selection for time series classification with random convolutional kernels
